cohort: 1,583,188 singletons liveborn ≥35 weeks of gestation in the period 2010-2019 in the Netherlands
finding: The risk of a low 5-min Apgar score increased over the last decade in the Netherlands, with the highest relative increase observed in subgroups of instrumental vaginal delivery and emergency caesarean section.
mod_finding: The risk of a low 5-min Apgar score increased over the last decade, with the highest relative increase observed in subgroups of instrumental vaginal delivery and emergency caesarean section.
